---
title: Formula reference
description: A compact index of high-use formulas with hypotheses and interpretation prompts.
page_type: resource
---

A formula is useful only with its hypotheses. Use this page for retrieval after
you can derive or explain the result in its course.

| Idea | Statement | Conditions to check |
|---|---|---|
| Quadratic roots | $x=(-b\pm\sqrt{b^2-4ac})/(2a)$ | $a\ne0$; real versus complex domain |
| Derivative definition | $f'(a)=\lim_{h\to0}[f(a+h)-f(a)]/h$ | The limit exists and is finite |
| Fundamental Theorem | $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx=F(b)-F(a)$ | $f$ continuous; $F'=f$ on the interval |
| Bayes' rule | $P(A\mid B)=P(B\mid A)P(A)/P(B)$ | $P(B)>0$ |
| Standardization | $z=(x-\mu)/\sigma$ | $\sigma>0$; interpretation depends on model |

Add formulas to your own reference with a derivation, units, failure cases, and
one example. A bare formula list encourages unsafe pattern matching.
